features.name: Java-origin properties on ordinary Kotlin subclasses
features.scope: Inherited Java getters/setters retain property syntax on source and compiled Kotlin subclasses, including virtual overrides, Boolean/acronym names, nullable/nonnull contracts, generic parents and Kotlin-added exact-type setters on Java-origin getters.
restrictions: Pure Kotlin getter-shaped functions stay ordinary methods. Mapped, interface and enum receivers remain bounded.
Implicit class-body assignments without explicit this receivers are outside the added write scope.

androidbible.remaining_boundary: Expected-result inference for implicit generic Java member call findViewById at line135.

limitations: No Android runtime or full-app claim. The source archive is the exact tested compiler tree based on the recorded revision plus this bounded feature.
